11766: A high school dropout because her school didn't approve of her working at Milk Hall, a cafe and bar, since they serve alcohol in the evening. She has feelings for Rikuo and frequently visits him at his part time job at the convenience store. Often seen with her pet crow, Kansuke.

127391: Chika used to date Rikuo in high school. She eventually broke up with him to date someone else. She has tendency to never turn someone down when they confess their feelings towards her, which leads to rumors and her nickname the "Queen of Disaster."

127394: Youichi attended the same high school as Haru. They both were taught by Shinako before Haru dropped out.
127397: Owner of the Milk Hall cafe and bar.
155104: Kinoshita is a coworker of Rikuo's, they both work part time at Nico Mart. He is a member of an amateur rock band called Wandering High.
